title: Judge orders pretrial detention for ousted president Peña in Ueno Bank case
detail: A Paraguayan judge has ordered pretrial detention for ousted president Santiago Peña in the Ueno Bank case, according to a news-aggregator summary; Middle East Eye's live blog separately reports he was taken into custody over the banking crisis. Only headline-level text was available to this update: the charges, the court and the detention location are not confirmed here.

title: BBC Mundo live: Peña reported under house arrest after removal by Congress
detail: BBC Mundo's live coverage carries a headline saying Santiago Peña was placed under house arrest after Congress removed him in the impeachment trial. Only the headline was available to this update; the court, charges and conditions are not confirmed here. Earlier reports in this tracker describe pretrial detention in the Ueno Bank case, so the form of custody (house arrest vs. detention) remains unreconciled.
